I am **Yuki Toyoda**, a professor at the Graduate School of Innovation Management, Hosei University (Tokyo). I teach MBA courses on business data analysis, research methodology, and marketing science. My research covers the methodology of qualitative comparative analysis (QCA) and its use in marketing and management.

## What this blog is for

- Explaining **threshold-sweep QCA** and the **ThSQCA** R package, step by step.
- Sharing browser-based **tools** for QCA and marketing research, built for teaching.
- Writing short notes on papers, methods, and teaching, in plain language.

Posts tagged **R** are also distributed through [R-bloggers](https://www.r-bloggers.com/) once the blog is registered there.

## A note on the tools

The tools are developed at the Yuki Toyoda Laboratory, Graduate School of Innovation Management, Hosei University, for learning. They may contain calculation errors, so please verify results with other software before using them in research or business.

## How this site was made

This site and its browser tools were developed with the assistance of Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic. I used Claude for writing and verifying the code of the tools, proofreading and translating the text, and building the website. The content and the analytical methods are my own, and I am responsible for them.
